summary: California Water Service Group filed an 8-K on October 14, 2026, disclosing a Note Purchase Agreement for $75 million of 6.08% Series C senior unsecured notes due December 15, 2031, and $50 million of 6.41% Series D notes due December 15, 2036. Subsidiary California Water Service Company entered a Bond Purchase Agreement for $50 million of 6.49% First Mortgage Bonds Series 4 due 2046 and $100 million of 6.54% Series 5 bonds due 2056. Proceeds refinance existing debt and fund general corporate purposes; issuance expected by December 31, 2026 privately to qualified institutional buyers under Rule 144A. This is a routine financing, not a special situation.
